viewpoints.label: Front gate
viewpoints.description: At the car gate between the stone boundary walls: the drive runs ahead to the deep car porch, and the glass front of the terrace sits above it on its charcoal frame.

viewpoints.label: Car porch
viewpoints.description: The car porch under the terrace slab, with the double front door ahead in its stone surround and the guard cabin standing to the right of the gate.
The foyer just inside the front door: grey-sand plaster, a full-height fluted travertine pier on the right, and the wide arch ahead into the double-height lounge.
The drawing room: a fluted travertine wall opposite the tall street window, a honed graphite stone floor and pale oak doors in stone-coloured casings.

viewpoints.label: Drawing room, window
viewpoints.description: The drawing room from its back corner, looking the length of the room to the street window and the fluted stone wall beside it.
The guest bath: graphite stone slabs to the ceiling, a backlit mirror over a floating stone basin and blackened steel fittings.
The dining room: a flat vein-cut travertine wall in the manner of the outside, a graphite stone floor and the side window onto the lawn.

viewpoints.label: Dining, side window
viewpoints.description: The dining room from the side window, looking back across the stone floor to the doors at the foyer.
The double-height lounge: a fluted travertine chimney rising the full 22 feet against the glass wall to the lawn, the gallery running above, and a graphite stone floor running to the glass.

viewpoints.label: Lounge, foyer arch
viewpoints.description: The lounge from below the gallery, looking back through the arch to the foyer, with the fluted chimney standing at the left edge of the glass wall.

viewpoints.label: Lounge, the chimney
viewpoints.description: The quiet end of the lounge, looking up the fluted travertine chimney and along the glass wall, with the gallery's balustrade crossing above.

The front of the stair hall between the lounge and the kitchen: grey-sand plaster, a stone floor and a linear light slot overhead, with the stair climbing above the solid plaster base under its landing.

viewpoints.label: Hall, back door
viewpoints.description: The back of the stair hall at the garden door, with the stone floor running back between the store and the laundry.

viewpoints.label: Foot of the stair
viewpoints.description: The foot of the dog-leg stair: the first flight rises ahead between plaster walls with stone treads, and the hall opens behind you.

viewpoints.label: Stair landing
viewpoints.description: The half landing of the dog-leg stair, where the first flight ends and the second turns back up to the gallery.

viewpoints.label: Foot of the second flight
viewpoints.description: The foot of the second flight, seen head on: it climbs beside the double-height lounge to the gallery.
The kitchen: graphite handleless lowers with blackened steel pulls, a pale stone island with a waterfall end and a stone splashback, with no timber anywhere.

viewpoints.label: Kitchen, the island
viewpoints.description: The stone island from the open floor, looking across it to the run of counters and the window over the sink.
The back kitchen: plain plaster, a quiet stone floor, a stone counter along the rear wall and the garden door beside it.
Bedroom 1: a flat travertine panel behind the bed, a pale oak floor and a wall of oak wardrobes.

viewpoints.label: Bedroom 1, window
viewpoints.description: Bedroom 1 from the door side, looking to the tall side window over the lawn and the stone floor beyond it.
The dressing room: pale oak wardrobes to the ceiling, plaster walls and an oak floor, with the bedroom door opposite.
Bath 1: graphite stone slabs floor to ceiling, a built-in stone tub under the rear window and a rain shower behind frameless glass.
The store at the back of the hall, finished plainly in plaster with a stone floor and one downlight.
Bedroom 2 at the wide end of its L: a travertine headboard panel, a pale oak floor and a wardrobe wall, with the bath and the side window beyond.
Bath 2: the graphite slab to the ceiling, a floating vanity, a wall-hung WC and a rain shower behind glass.
The laundry beside the hall: a stone counter along one wall, a stone floor and a single downlight.

viewpoints.label: Top of the stair
viewpoints.description: The top of the stair, arriving on the gallery: the lounge's void opens beside you and the walkway runs on toward the bedrooms.
The gallery, the walkway that wraps the lounge's void: a glass balustrade on its inner edge, stone underfoot and the bedrooms opening off it.

viewpoints.label: Gallery, over the void
viewpoints.description: The gallery's inner edge above the lounge, looking down past the glass balustrade into the double-height room and at the fluted chimney across the void.

viewpoints.label: Gallery walkway
viewpoints.description: The four-foot walkway along the void's north edge, with the glass balustrade at the left and the lounge floor twenty-two feet below.

viewpoints.label: Bedroom 3
viewpoints.description: Bedroom 3 over the drawing room: a fluted travertine headboard wall, an oak floor and a wardrobe wall, with the front window beside it.

viewpoints.label: Bath 3
viewpoints.description: Bath 3: graphite stone slabs floor to ceiling, a floating vanity, a wall-hung WC and a rain shower behind glass.

viewpoints.label: Master bedroom
viewpoints.description: The master bedroom over the dining room: a fluted travertine headboard wall, an oak floor and a sliding glass door to the terrace.

viewpoints.label: Master bedroom, terrace door
viewpoints.description: The master bedroom from the headboard wall, looking to the sliding glass door and the terrace beyond it.
The dressing room between the master bedroom and its bath: pale oak wardrobes, plaster walls and an oak floor.
The master bath: graphite slab to the ceiling, a backlit mirror over a floating vanity, and the stone tub set below the rear window.
The first-floor terrace over the car porch: stone paving, glass on three sides and the street below, with the lounge's glass wall at the left.

viewpoints.label: Terrace, end
viewpoints.description: The far end of the terrace, looking back along the glass screen to the terrace door and the master suite.

viewpoints.label: Bedroom 4
viewpoints.description: Bedroom 4: a flat travertine headboard panel, an oak floor and a wall of wardrobes, with the side window over the lawn.

viewpoints.label: Bath 4
viewpoints.description: Bath 4: graphite slab to the ceiling, a floating vanity, a wall-hung WC and a rain shower behind glass.

viewpoints.label: Bedroom 5
viewpoints.description: Bedroom 5: a flat travertine headboard panel, an oak floor and a wardrobe wall, with the side window over the rear garden.

viewpoints.label: Dressing 5
viewpoints.description: The dressing room beside bedroom 5: oak wardrobes down one side, plaster walls and an oak floor.

viewpoints.label: Bath 5
viewpoints.description: Bath 5: graphite slab to the ceiling, a floating vanity and the stone tub set against the rear wall.
The family lounge overlooking the void: a fluted travertine media wall, an oak floor and the gallery's glass balustrade at its open edge.

viewpoints.label: Family lounge, the gallery
viewpoints.description: The family lounge from the media wall, looking through the wide opening to the gallery and the stair.

viewpoints.label: Bedroom 6
viewpoints.description: Bedroom 6 at the rear: a flat travertine headboard panel, an oak floor and the bath and dressing room opening off it.

viewpoints.label: Bath 6
viewpoints.description: Bath 6: graphite slab to the ceiling, a floating vanity, a wall-hung WC and a rain shower behind glass.

viewpoints.label: Dressing 6
viewpoints.description: The dressing room beside bedroom 6: oak wardrobes along the rear wall, plaster walls and an oak floor.

viewpoints.label: Lounge, the hearth
viewpoints.description: The lounge from the middle of the floor: the fluted travertine chimney ahead at the left, the gallery crossing above it and the glass wall running the full height of the room.

viewpoints.label: Lounge, the chimney
viewpoints.description: Close to the fluted travertine chimney, looking up its stone face to the roof slab, with the glass wall to the lawn at its side.

viewpoints.label: Lounge, the glass wall
viewpoints.description: Along the glass wall at the quiet end of the lounge, looking back across the stone floor to the gallery and the chimney.

viewpoints.label: Gallery, north walk
viewpoints.description: The gallery's north walkway, with the glass balustrade on the right and the bedrooms opening off the far end.

viewpoints.label: Gallery, east walk
viewpoints.description: The east side of the gallery above the lounge, looking down past the balustrade to the chimney and the glass wall.

viewpoints.label: Gallery, by the family lounge
viewpoints.description: The gallery where it meets the family lounge, looking back toward the stair and the void.

viewpoints.label: Hall, beside the stair
viewpoints.description: The hall beside the stair, reached from the lounge: the flight rises to the gallery, and the doors to the bedrooms, store and laundry run along the spine.

viewpoints.label: Hall, middle
viewpoints.description: The middle of the hall, with the store door on the left and the bedroom and laundry doors along the right.
